title: Two Plans for One Car
story: The family shared one car and one online calendar, but the calendar had not been updated after Dad's late meeting. On Saturday morning both parents arrived in the hall with keys and different plans. Mum needed the market, and Dad needed the clinic. Their son, Elias, opened the app and saw that the meeting change was still only in Dad's email. He added the new time, then suggested a simple order. Mum could take the car first, and Dad could go after the market run. They agreed, slightly annoyed with themselves. Elias also turned on a reminder so a change in one inbox would not surprise the whole household again.

quiz.explanation: Elias turns on a reminder so a change sitting in one inbox, meaning one email folder, will not surprise everyone.
